crossRefs.note: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
“Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he…
I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with…
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples, and said, “Take…
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

translations.web: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
translations.bsb: “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
translations.kjv: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
translations.asv: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.
